apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.29.3 | YTKACE_21.29.3_0.6.8

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!

> #### A new free and [open-source](https://github.com/Epic0001/YTKACE) YouTube enhancer for iOS with downloads, SponsorBlock, player controls, and interface customization.

>[!NOTE]
>[Altstore source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdrvt99/Altstore-Repository/main/ytkace.json) is available now!
>no YTUHD. it is broken in +21.25.5 versions as of now. max resolution is 1080p60. devices with native AV1 can still see 4K.

> What's new:
> • Added profile picture preview with zoom and save
> • Added an option to remove the launch animation
> • Added OLED mode for the startup animation
> • Added Downloads to YouTube's native settings
> • Added a global downloaded video and audio mini-player
>• Added Light, Dark, and OLED themes to the download progress UI

> Fixed:
> • Fixed periodic video and audio interruptions with Fix Playback
> • Fixed the download mini-player only appearing inside the YTKACE tab
> • Improved download request refreshing and retry handling
> • Improved long-download reliability
> • Improved download progress UI theme switching
> • Reduced startup lag
